The decisions of the Traffic Safety Committee are advisory to the City Council, and the City
Council will take formal action to approve or deny said decisions at their meeting on Tuesday,
March 24, 2015. Interested persons who wish to object to the decision may speak to the Council
with their concerns. As these decisions are typically on the Consent Calendar, the person must ask
the Council during the appropriate time at the beginning of the meeting to “pull” the item from the
Consent Calendar for discussion.

ACTION MEMO
  TRAFFIC SAFETY COMMITTEE
  MEETING

Council Chambers - City Hall  Wednesday
340 Palos Verdes Drive West  March 11, 2015
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274  7:30 PM

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL  Committee Members Beall, King, Leach and Vice-Chair Kao present.
  Chairman Buss absent (pre-scheduled)

COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC
 Montemalaga Cove Plaza Parking - Deborah Gaume

  Action:  No action at this time.

OLD BUSINESS
1. Via Segunda Cut-Thru Traffic

  Traffic Safety Committee member Beall moved (seconded by Traffic Safety Committee
  member Leach) to recommend installation of curve warning and speed limit signs on Via
  Campesina in the vicinity of Via Segunda as recommended by the Consulting City Traffic
  Engineer. The vote was 4 in favor (Buss absent).

NEW BUSINESS

2. Via Almar Additional Radar Speed Feedback Sign

  Traffic Safety Committee member Beall moved (seconded by Traffic Safety Committee
  member King) to recommend: 1) Continued rotation of radar speed feedback signs between
  the currently approved locations; 2) Purchase of additional radar speed feedback signs for
  use throughout the City; and, 3) Opposition to taking private donations for radar speed
  feedback signs if the signs have conditions on their use. The vote was 4 in favor (Buss
  absent).

  Actions taken by this Committee are advisory.
  The City Council will take action on all appropriate items on Tuesday, March 24, 2015.
